liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the Morning Dew outstanding, standing alone among the year's performances; Reviewer recommends the Morning Dew that comes out of Terrapin Station to Dew fans [12][20]
- **//St. Stephen** (1 other source): The St. Stephen on this copy is clipped [2]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the Terrapin Station into Morning Dew pairing as incredible and wishes such pairings were more frequent [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-02-27.168957.sony.ecm280.menke.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 155 min [1]
- **gd1977-02-27.145195.sony.ecm280.bertrando.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 18 songs; 151 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd77-02-27.bertrando.vernon.10378.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 149 min; rated 4.12/5 by 58 [3]. Said about its sound: On this audience tape, Billy and Mickey's drums come through strongly and rock hard; Reviewer hears constant hiss, echo, and distant-sounding vocals, nothing like a soundboard; Reviewer rates the sound very highly, saying it sets a high bar for 1970s audience recordings [14][17][18]
- **gd1977-02-27.143884.SonyECM-280.bertrando.warburton.smith.sirmick.flac2496**: source not stated; 17 songs; 151 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [5]

## Around the show

- Unless they attended the previous night, the audience had not heard Terrapin Station; the album came out months later [20]
- Disc 2 track 6 does not exist; that was a naming error and the show is complete [3]
- Just before St. Stephen, Ramrod came down the aisle and took Bob's and Rhino's decks and tapes, leaving the mics [5]
- Reviewer places the show among the best of 1977, saying it stands out even relative to the rest of the year [12]
- Reviewer says the previous night, 2-26-77, was full of first-time songs, yet this show is special too [16]
- Reviewer rates the Scarlet jam and St. Stephen here above those of 5-8-77 [16]
- Reviewer judges this show better than the previous night's and consistently tight throughout [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-02-27.168957.sony.ecm280.menke.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: SET 1: Sony ECM-280's > Bob's TC-158 > Korg SET 2: Samson only; one ECM-280, one ECM-22p > Bob's 158 > Korg From St. Stephen on; one ECM-280, one ECM-22p >… [1]. Also: Source is Bob Menke's master cassettes and transfer, with Charlie Miller coordinating the effort; A 16-second soundboard patch from Charlie Miller covers the beginning of Morning Dew [1]
- **gd1977-02-27.145195.sony.ecm280.bertrando.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Rob Bertrando; transferred by Matt Smith, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Bertrando's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-280 mics > Sony TC-153SD > Rob Bertrando's 1st generation reels @ 3.75 ips [2]. Also: A 12-second soundboard patch opens Morning Dew; the cut was tightened and is now noted [2]
- **gd77-02-27.bertrando.vernon.10378.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Rob Bertrando; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-280 [3]. Also: Reviewer believes the show is little known because it circulates poorly and no soundboard is available; Taped by Dr. Rob Bertrando on Sony ECM-280 mics into a Sony TC-153SD, then DAT and CDR; seeded by Matt Vernon [3][10]
- **gd1977-02-27.143884.SonyECM-280.bertrando.warburton.smith.sirmick.flac2496**: taped by Rob Bertrando; transferred by Jimmy Warburton and Matt Smith and Sirmick; source: Sony ECM-280s > Sony TC-153SD > Cassette Master > Reel > Reel - Taped by Dr. Rob Bertrando, Jimmy Warburton's copy. [5]. Also: Menke, Hohlwein and Bertrando taped from Bertrando's mics; cables were rerouted after the bust, so St. Stephen's start is missing [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [Robertson Gym, UC Santa Barbara, Goleta, CA - 02/27/1977 - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/robertson-gym-uc-santa-barbara-goleta-ca-02271977/) [29]
